author: Zephyr I
title: Ratio ablation at wider CNN: Double-step+AttnPool (ConvLSTM 48ch), 56/112 CNN, d=5, ratio=0.5 — BASE_SEED=42
abstract: At 56/112 width, test whether lowering bottleneck_ratio to 0.5 preserves throughput and improves solve rate vs ratio=0.6. Compute-equalized double-step LN-ConvLSTM (48ch) + single-head AttnPool.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from ray import tune
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_double_step_dilated_bottleneck import DoubleStepLNConvLSTM

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([56]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([112]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([48]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([5]),
        'attn_temp': tune.choice([1.0]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return DoubleStepLNConvLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        bottleneck_ratio=hparams['bottleneck_ratio'],
        dilation=hparams['dilation'],
        stop_grad_first=False,
        attn_temp=hparams['attn_temp'],
    )
